title: AntennaPod In-Progress Abandon Rate
dataSources: AntennaPod episodes (`antennapod:episode`), Audible listening sessions (`audible:listen`), Goodreads audiobooks (`goodreads:audiobook`), podcast queues (`podcast:queue`), and listening streaks (`listen:streak`).
app: AntennaPod listening exports, Audible progress logs, Goodreads audiobook shelves, podcast queue snapshots, and listening streak counters ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=antennapod:episode playback_status=* playback_seconds=* episode_minutes=*
| eval completion_pct=round(100*playback_seconds/(episode_minutes*60),1)
| eval abandoned=if(playback_status="started" AND completion_pct<20,1,0)
| stats sum(abandoned) as abandoned_episodes, count as started_episodes by podcast_name
| eval abandon_pct=round(100*abandoned_episodes/started_episodes,1)
| sort - abandon_pct
| head 15
description: Measures how often episodes are started but abandoned below twenty percent completion by podcast.
value: High abandon rates flag shows that looked good in the feed but did not earn your attention.
implementation: Export AntennaPod playback with `playback_seconds` and `episode_minutes`, then rank podcasts by abandon rate.
visualization: Bar chart of abandon percentage by podcast.
grandmaExplanation: It spots which podcasts you keep starting but rarely stick with past the opening.
